title: Pregnancy comfort kit
blurb: Small things that make the months before baby easier.

items.name: Momcozy U-Shaped Pregnancy Pillow
items.why: Supports belly, back and hips at once, so side-sleeping is bearable.

items.name: KeaBabies Pregnancy Belly Band
items.why: Soft support for your back and bump, and lets you wear your jeans longer.

items.name: Iron Flask 40 oz Bottle with Straw
items.why: Hydration matters more now, and a big insulated bottle means fewer refills.

items.name: Growing You Keepsake Pregnancy Journal
items.why: Guided pages for appointments, milestones and notes to baby.

items.name: Kindred Bravely Compression Socks
items.why: Firm support for swollen ankles on long days and flights.

title: Hospital bag checklist
blurb: Pack it by week 36. Everything here earns its place.

items.name: SWOMOG 3-in-1 Maternity and Nursing Robe
items.why: Works for labor, skin-to-skin and the first feeds.

items.name: Anker 10 ft USB-C Charging Cable
items.why: Hospital outlets are never by the bed. Older iPhones need a Lightning cable instead.

items.name: Simple Joys by Carter's Sleep and Play, 3-Pack
items.why: Zip-up going-home outfits, with spares for blowouts.

items.name: Frida Upside Down Peri Bottle
items.why: The angled nozzle makes postpartum care much easier.

items.name: Batiste Dry Shampoo Mini, 3-Pack
items.why: Feel human again without a full shower.

items.name: Graco SnugRide Lite LX Infant Car Seat
items.why: Light to carry, and you can't leave the hospital without a seat installed.

title: Newborn must-haves
blurb: The short list for the first twelve weeks.

items.name: aden + anais Essentials Muslin Swaddles, 4-Pack
items.why: Breathable cotton that helps newborns feel secure and settle.

items.name: Chicco LullaGo Anywhere Portable Bassinet
items.why: A safe sleep space next to your bed that folds for travel.

items.name: Pampers Swaddlers Size 0, 84 Count
items.why: Soft, with a wetness line. You'll use 8 to 12 a day at first.

items.name: WaterWipes Sensitive+ Baby Wipes, 4 Packs
items.why: Almost all water, gentle on brand-new skin.

items.name: Burt's Bees Baby Organic Burp Cloths, 5-Pack
items.why: Big and absorbent. You can never have too many.

items.name: Hatch Baby Sound Machine and Night Light
items.why: White noise, a soft light and later a time-to-rise clock, all in one.

title: Infant stage favorites
blurb: For rolling, sitting, starting solids and teething.

items.name: Graco Slim Snacker Highchair
items.why: Folds flat and stands on its own, good for smaller kitchens.

items.name: Nuby NanaNubs Teether
items.why: A soft banana-shaped massager that reaches the back gums.

items.name: Skip Hop 3-in-1 Tummy Time Mat
items.why: A padded play space for tummy time, rolling and sitting.

items.name: KeaBabies Suction Plates with Lids, 3-Pack
items.why: Silicone plates that stay put and store leftovers.

items.name: 4our Kiddies 56-Piece Baby Proofing Kit
items.why: Locks, outlet covers, corner guards and anchors in one box.

title: Toddler essentials
blurb: Gear for walkers, talkers and big feelings.

items.name: Munchkin Snack Catcher, 2-Pack
items.why: Soft flaps keep snacks in and crumbs out of the car seat.

items.name: Graco Ready2Jet Travel Stroller
items.why: About 13 pounds, folds one-handed and fits overhead bins.

items.name: Dr. Brown's Toddler Toothbrush, 2-Pack
items.why: Small heads and chunky handles make brushing go better.

items.name: Munchkin Sturdy Toddler Toilet Seat
items.why: Sits firmly on the big toilet, ready for the first signs of interest.

items.name: The Little Blue Boxed Set of 4 Board Books
items.why: Four Dr. Seuss Bright and Early classics with sturdy pages.

title: Baby shower gifts under $50
blurb: Thoughtful gifts parents will actually use.

items.name: Konssy Swaddle Blanket and Beanie Set
items.why: Stretchy and soft, and sweet in newborn photos.

items.name: Parker Baby Felt Diaper Caddy
items.why: Keeps diapers, wipes and cream in one grab-and-go basket.

items.name: Pearhead First 5 Years Memory Book
items.why: Guided pages plus a clean-touch ink pad for hand and footprints.

items.name: JolyWell Dimmable Nursery Night Light
items.why: Rechargeable, with a timer and a soft glow for 3 a.m. feeds.
